tasks.title: Harden auth for production readiness
scope: Frontend access-token refresh flow with retry
Replace auth email URL console logs with real mail provider
Add auth integration tests for register/login/refresh/logout/reset
progressNotes: Completed frontend refresh flow with automatic retry through shared web API client.
Added integration test coverage for 401 -> /auth/refresh -> retried request success in apps/web/src/lib/api-client.test.ts.
Wired API auth verification/reset email sending to Resend via EmailService and removed auth URL console log placeholders.
Added passing API integration tests for register/login/refresh/logout/reset in apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.integration.test.ts.
Hardened backend auth by making DI explicit for auth controller/service/repository under the current test runtime and ensuring refresh token rotation includes a unique jti.
Added verify-email route coverage to the API auth integration suite, including send-verification-email -> verify-email -> emailVerified assertion.
Fixed the billing webhook Stripe typing so package-wide API typecheck is green again.
Added a GitHub Actions workflow that provisions Postgres, pushes the Prisma schema, seeds plans, runs the focused API auth integration suite, and runs API typecheck.
Pending first green GitHub Actions run before marking this task complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Expired access token can recover through refresh without forcing re-login
Verify-email and reset-password send through configured mail provider
Auth critical-path tests pass in CI/local
